bundle.shortDescription: Offline-first point of sale for retail and restaurant shops
bundle.longDescription: Diwan is an offline-first, module-configurable point of sale system for small retail and restaurant businesses — billing, inventory, tables, staff attendance, expenses, salary and reporting, all running locally with no internet dependency.
